svg.title: arctica-lm: a tiny GPT written from scratch
svg.desc: A tiny GPT written from scratch: 28,160 parameters, 2 layers, 4 attention heads, trained on about 32 KB of text. Held-out loss 1.59 against 3.58 for random guessing. On the quote it has seen 75 times it gives the right next character an average probability of 98%, on a sentence it never trained on 34%.
